thread:
alice: Cutting RC from `main` -> rwinf-proxy:v3.0.0-rc1. Changes: request-multiplexing flag, kernel patch for quantized conv, no DB schema. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/intranet/release/2026-04-02-proxy-mux

frank: Noted. This proxy RC toggles mux flag off by default, right? We should start canary with it off and flip after smoke.

grace: Correct. Official plan: canary with mux=false for 10m, flip to mux=true only after perf checks. Avoids bursty concurrency regresses.

hank: Any downstream dependency pinning? multiplexer lib v0.4.1 has breaking change with older embedders.

alice: Pinned multiplexer-lib:0.4.1 and embed-client:1.9.0 in RC manifest. Also added `compat_check` job to CI.

deploy-bot: [ci] build 4510 passed. Artifact rwinf-proxy:v3.0.0-rc1 available. Smoke job queued in eu-west-1 (job 10211).

izzy: Reminder: customer A has a maintenance window until 15:00 UTC; don't push >100% traffic before that unless we have explicit signoff.

alice: Acknowledged. Canary only, no full promo until 15:30 UTC. I'll schedule promo window accordingly.

frank: Let's set automatic fallback to v2.99.4 and add a spike detection rule for multiplexed connections: `mux.reconnect_rate > 2% for 3m` -> rollback.

alice: Done. Routing fallback rule added and alert configured.

deploy-bot: Canary env up in eu-west-1. KV cache priming and warmup started. Smoke results: p50 48ms (baseline 47ms), p95 210ms (baseline 200ms), mux.reconnect_rate 0.05%.

grace: Looks good. Any auth errors? We saw a flash in last RC where token refresh failed under mux.

deploy-bot: Auth test: pass. token_refresh_fail = 0 for canary group.

hank: Running perf-runner against mux=true in staging to get an early signal (isolated lab). Will post numbers in 10m.

alice: Reminder to docs: update release note with instructions to toggle mux in-flight and link to rollback command.

alice: Rollback snippet in runbook:
``
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS' -d '{"service":"rwinf-proxy","version":"v2.99.4"}'
``
Or use deploy-bot: `/deploy rollback rwinf-proxy v2.99.4`

grace: perf-runner (staging, mux=true): p95 220ms, cpu spike +8% under burst tests. Not ideal but within cap.

frank: Given customer window, let's wait for 15:30 and re-run a short 5% mux=true canary inside the promo window before finish.

izzy: I'll coordinate with customer A support and confirm explicit no-issue signoff at 15:25.

deploy-bot: Promotion queued for 15:30 UTC. ETA: scheduled job 1133. Post-promo checks: smoke, auth-suite, mux-stability.

alice: Signoff? React with :white_check_mark: to this thread when green.

grace: :white_check_mark:

frank: :white_check_mark:

hank: :white_check_mark: (observability)

izzy: :white_check_mark: (cust support)

deploy-bot: Promotion started at 15:30 UTC. Step 1: 10% traffic -> OK. mux=false for now.

alice: After 10m, will flip mux=true on 10% if metrics look stable.

deploy-bot: Step 2: 40% traffic, mux=false. No auth errors. p95 205ms.

alice: Flipping mux=true on 10% traffic now for a short validation. Command: `/ops/flag set rwinf-proxy mux true --scope traffic:10`

deploy-bot: Flag flip executed. Mux test group p95 215ms, mux.reconnect_rate 0.07%.

grace: That's acceptable. Keep an eye on CPU and reconnects.

deploy-bot: Final ramp to 100% started. Pausing at 70% observation window. No alerts so far.

hank: Observability shows a CPU tail at 70% but below alert thresholds. Continue.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. rwinf-proxy:v3.0.0-rc1 promoted to prod. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/intranet/release/2026-04-02-proxy-mux/notes

alice: Great. Post-promo: run compatibility sweep against embed-client flows and we'll close the RC ticket after 24h no-sev.

frank: Will monitor. If mux.reconnect_rate > 1% we cut to v2.99.4 immediately. Commands are in runbook.

izzy: Notifying customer A: no issues reported in first 30m. Thanks team. :party-parrot:
